capabilities: Suggests previously used external links while typing a Markdown link
Browses every external link in the vault with the notes that use it
Edits a link's text or URL in all notes at once, with preview and undo
Lists a note's external links at the end of the note
Exposes the link index to scripts, dataviewjs and MCP agents
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. The script query interface may still change. The plugin makes no network requests; MCP tools are served by Local REST API on the user's machine behind its API key.
problem: Reusing an external URL means hunting for it again, and inconsistent link texts or URLs are hard to find and fix across a whole vault.
summary: Suggests external links already used in the vault while typing a Markdown link, and adds a link browser, vault-wide link editing and per-note link lists.
